question: Do short grayscale frame sequences plus ego-motion improve local depth, free-space, and discontinuity estimates over a parameter-matched single-frame baseline on held-out procedural geometry?

split_policy.prohibition: No scene seed may appear in more than one split. Test metrics are computed only after both model runs finish.

primary_comparison: temporal-convgru minus single-frame on the held-out test seeds
claim_boundary: This run can establish only whether the compact temporal apparatus improves held-out procedural-geometry metrics relative to its matched single-frame baseline. It cannot establish mesh reconstruction, navigation competence, or cross-game transfer.
